text.autoconfig.tieredneo.title: TieredNeo Config
text.autoconfig.tieredneo.option.lootCon: Items in for example mineshaft chests get modifiers
text.autoconfig.tieredneo.option.entityI: Equipped items on entities get modifiers
text.autoconfig.tieredneo.option.reforge: Decreases the biggest weights by this modifier
text.autoconfig.tieredneo.option.herosLe:
Modify the biggest weights by this modifier per smithing level
IMPORTANT: Make sure there's a smithing skill in your datapack in Hero's Levels
text.autoconfig.tieredneo.option.luckRef: Modify the biggest weights by this modifier per luck
text.autoconfig.tieredneo.option.uniqueR: Allows you to reforge Unique tier
text.autoconfig.tieredneo.option.legenda: Enable/Disable special colors in attributes for Legendary/Unique
commands.tieredneo.failed: Nothing changed. %s main hand is empty
commands.tieredneo.untier_failed: Nothing changed. %s from %s has no tier
commands.tieredneo.tiering_failed: Nothing changed. %s from %s has no given tier
